purpose: Reproducible development retrieval pilot; not training data, a held-out benchmark, expert certification or diagnostic accuracy.

specific_semantic_cases.query: During startup the channel has been assigned to a mode group incorrectly or more than once. Which configuration entry does the manual associate with this problem?
An axis encoder reports a hardware fault while it is being initialized or accessed. Which section describes that initialization failure?
The NCK backup battery has reached its early low-voltage warning level. What replacement time window is stated in the manual?
Low backup-battery voltage is detected while the NCK is powering up. Why does the manual warn about previously buffered data?
A new memory-configuration machine-data value is rejected because it would exceed available user memory. What do memory type letters D and S mean in this message?
The NC file system has reached its maximum number of files or part programs. Which manual entry explains this file-count limit?
A program block fails its grammar check after text containing non-ASCII characters is pasted into it. Which section discusses this possible character-related cause?
A measurement-cycle logfile is rejected because of its filename extension. Which extensions does the manual permit?
An initial G8x drilling-cycle call is missing its total depth or individual drilling depth. Which parameter letters does the manual identify?
The HMI Operate release requires a different CNC software version. Which manual section explains the risk of malfunctions or display problems from that mismatch?
PROFINET reports input IOPS=BAD at a logical start address for an NCK I/O slot. Which section describes that failure?
The PLC basic program was not initialized because LBP_ConfigBP was not called in the startup organization block. Which section documents this omission?
The machine warns that a factory-standard password is still active for the manufacturer, service, or user access level. What does the manual recommend?
The configured directory for a measurement logfile does not exist or its path is wrong. Which log-name parameter does the manual reference?
The required PLC data blocks exist but are too small to be used. Which manual section describes this size problem?
One or more CNC options have been activated, but no license key has been entered at all. Which licensing message matches that situation?

ambiguous_review_cases.query: The mode group and channel are not ready and a system error is displayed. What information should I send to Technical Support?
During startup or after a reset, the operator panel has no NC/PLC communication and its displayed values are invalid. Can this be a temporary ramp-up condition?
A measurement logfile path is invalid or points to a missing directory. Which parameter is identified in the manual for checking that path?
